newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGS unchanged in quiet trade late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGS unchanged in quiet trade late.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were unchanged in very quiet trade late on Friday, with many players leaving early for the weekend.
A Golf tournament in the Midwest also took many traders away for the day Friday.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held largely steady between 53.50 and 54.00 cents a gallon.
Conway, Kansas, hub also remained 53.75/54.25 in quiet trade.
Prices have slowly climbed back up after plunging on EIA government data on Wednesday that showed strong U.S. builds.
Much of the strength came from crop drying demand. On Thursday, the Todhunter terminal in Ohio ran out of supply and said it would not see propane refills until Sunday.
The terminal has the capacity to store 792,000 barrels of propane, much of it then supplied to farmers.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
